descriptionHtml:
KNOWN BUG-UI-3. lab.js: coupon is set only on «Застосувати»; clearing the input does not reset it, so every recalculation (delivery change, quantity ±) re-sends the rejected code → «422 · Невідомий промокод», empty totals, «Оформити» disabled. The only way out is «Застосувати» with an empty field; there is no «remove coupon» control.

The test asserts the behaviour required by spec.txt; it stays red until the server is fixed.
